# inspect.lua 3.1.3

Unmodified `inspect.lua` from the upstream
[v3.1.3 tag](https://github.com/kikito/inspect.lua/tree/v3.1.3):

- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kikito/inspect.lua/v3.1.3/inspect.lua
- SHA-256: `72de901ac081bf927640e367b52146a18ed4f628eab7880dd32f1a6442b9fe6f`
- Author: Enrique García Cota.
- License: MIT; the complete notice is embedded at the top of `inspect.lua` and
  is preserved in the installed module and packaged archive.

The upstream file in this tag still reports `inspect.lua 3.1.0` in its
`_VERSION` field. The vendored identity is the tag and SHA-256 above.

This copy makes example preparation work offline. `prepare.sh` installs it into
`.deps/rocks/share/lua/5.4/inspect.lua`, the same source-module layout used by a
LuaRocks tree. No LuaRocks executable is required for the example.
